relations.statement: A separation task on inscriptions a and ab is well-posed only if both are admitted, retained across turns and replayed in the current state.
relations.hypotheses: State contains no comparison, counting or matching operation beyond admission.

relations.statement: Admission of ab beside a with no comparison, counting or matching yields no regime behaviour that differs between a and ab.
relations.hypotheses: The regime has only admission, retention and replay acts.

relations.statement: A licensed lift candidate requires replay availability, reduction and closure; a missing new carrier blocks it.

lemmas.statement: Separation of a and ab is evaluable only after ab is admitted, retained and replayed.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem lem_order (admitted retained replayed posed : Prop) (h : posed → admitted ∧ retained ∧ replayed) : posed → admitted := fun p => (h p).1

lemmas.statement: With admission only, no observable differs between a and ab, so no unique continuation is dictated.

near_misses.claim: Supplying ab as data is the uniquely forced first addition.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Writing ab into a rule pattern is equally minimal, so neither is uniquely forced.

near_misses.claim: Admitting ab beside a already makes them internally distinguishable.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: No comparison, counting or matching exists, so nothing reacts differently.
